Context: (vii) Timing restrictions.-

## (vii) Timing restrictions.-  
| Length of absence | Amount Payable |
| ---------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------ |
| If absence from headquarters is < 6 hours | 30% of Lumpsum amount |
| If absence from headquarters is between 6-12 hours | 70% of Lumpsum amount |
| If absence from headquarters is > 12 hours | 100% of Lumpsum amount |  
Absence from Headquarter will midnight and will be calculated on a per day basis.  
be reckoned from midnight to -GIO (1), SR 71.
